up: Retrieve all compounds with an IC50 activity value in nM against the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2815 (human high-affinity nerve growth factor receptor). Return the following information: the compound's ChEMBL ID, the compound's canonical SMILES string, the assay description, the target's preferred name, and the target's organism. Also provide the PubMed ID or DOI associated with the activity record.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  ass.description,
  td.pref_name,
  td.organism,
  d.pubmed_id,
  d.doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2815'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
